examples.english: The meeting came to an abrupt end when the fire alarm went off.
examples.persian: جلسه با به صدا درآمدن زنگ آتش‌نشانی به طور ناگهانی پایان یافت.

miniContext: The meeting came to an abrupt end when the fire alarm went off.

examples.english: Despite the pressure, she gave a coherent and well-organized presentation.
examples.persian: او با وجود فشار، ارائه‌ای منسجم و منظم داد.

miniContext: Despite the pressure, she gave a coherent and well-organized presentation.

examples.english: The bright red car was conspicuous among the rows of gray sedans.
examples.persian: ماشین قرمز روشن در میان ردیف سدان‌های خاکستری بسیار آشکار بود.

miniContext: The bright red car was conspicuous among the rows of gray sedans.

examples.english: Climbing the mountain in winter was an arduous journey that took three days.
examples.persian: صعود از کوه در زمستان سفری سخت و طاقت‌فرسا بود که سه روز طول کشید.

miniContext: Climbing the mountain in winter was an arduous journey that took three days.

examples.english: Lab tests showed that his diet was deficient in iron.
examples.persian: آزمایش‌های پزشکی نشان داد که رژیم غذایی او از نظر آهن ناکافی است.

miniContext: Lab tests showed that his diet was deficient in iron.

examples.english: The museum's antique vase was too delicate to touch without gloves.
examples.persian: گلدان عتیقه موزه بسیار ظریف و حساس بود و بدون دستکش نمی‌شد لمسش کرد.

miniContext: The museum's antique vase was too delicate to touch without gloves.

examples.english: Smoking has a detrimental effect on lung health.
examples.persian: سیگار کشیدن اثر زیان‌آوری بر سلامت ریه دارد.

miniContext: Smoking has a detrimental effect on lung health.

examples.english: Learning a new language as an adult can be difficult but rewarding.
examples.persian: یادگیری یک زبان جدید در بزرگسالی می‌تواند دشوار اما ارزشمند باشد.

miniContext: Learning a new language as an adult can be difficult but rewarding.

examples.english: The software splits the task into several discrete steps.
examples.persian: این نرم‌افزار کار را به چند مرحله جدا و مجزا تقسیم می‌کند.

miniContext: The software splits the task into several discrete steps.

examples.english: These hiking boots are durable enough to last for years of rough trails.
examples.persian: این کفش‌های کوهنوردی به اندازه کافی بادوام هستند که سال‌ها در مسیرهای سخت دوام بیاورند.

miniContext: These hiking boots are durable enough to last for years of rough trails.

examples.english: Please label the box fragile since it contains glass ornaments.
examples.persian: لطفاً روی جعبه بنویسید شکننده، چون شامل تزئینات شیشه‌ای است.

miniContext: Please label the box fragile since it contains glass ornaments.

examples.english: Building a bridge across the river is technically feasible but very expensive.
examples.persian: ساختن پل روی رودخانه از نظر فنی عملی و شدنی است اما بسیار پرهزینه.

miniContext: Building a bridge across the river is technically feasible but very expensive.

examples.english: The chess champion proved to be a formidable opponent for every challenger.
examples.persian: قهرمان شطرنج برای هر رقیبی حریفی ترسناک و چالش‌برانگیز بود.

miniContext: The chess champion proved to be a formidable opponent for every challenger.

examples.english: Her astute observation helped the team spot the error in the budget.
examples.persian: مشاهده زیرکانه و هوشمندانه او به تیم کمک کرد اشتباه موجود در بودجه را پیدا کند.

miniContext: Her astute observation helped the team spot the error in the budget.

examples.english: Excessive sun exposure can be harmful to the skin.
examples.persian: قرار گرفتن بیش از حد در معرض آفتاب می‌تواند برای پوست مضر باشد.

miniContext: Excessive sun exposure can be harmful to the skin.

examples.english: The shelter's supplies were inadequate for the number of families seeking help.
examples.persian: ملزومات پناهگاه برای تعداد خانواده‌هایی که به دنبال کمک بودند ناکافی بود.

miniContext: The shelter's supplies were inadequate for the number of families seeking help.

examples.english: His story was inconsistent with what he had told the police earlier.
examples.persian: داستان او با آنچه قبلاً به پلیس گفته بود ناسازگار بود.

miniContext: His story was inconsistent with what he had told the police earlier.

examples.english: The old cough syrup proved ineffective against her persistent cold.
examples.persian: شربت سرفه قدیمی در برابر سرماخوردگی مداوم او بی‌اثر بود.

miniContext: The old cough syrup proved ineffective against her persistent cold.

examples.english: There was insufficient evidence to convict the defendant.
examples.persian: شواهد برای محکوم کردن متهم ناکافی بود.

miniContext: There was insufficient evidence to convict the defendant.

examples.english: The watchmaker spent weeks assembling the intricate gears of the clock.
examples.persian: ساعت‌ساز هفته‌ها وقت صرف کرد تا چرخ‌دنده‌های پیچیده و ظریف ساعت را سر هم کند.

miniContext: The watchmaker spent weeks assembling the intricate gears of the clock.

examples.english: She prefers moderate exercise, like a thirty-minute walk, over intense workouts.
examples.persian: او تمرین متوسط و معتدل، مانند پیاده‌روی سی دقیقه‌ای، را به تمرینات شدید ترجیح می‌دهد.

miniContext: She prefers moderate exercise, like a thirty-minute walk, over intense workouts.

examples.english: The workload during finals week felt overwhelming to most students.
examples.persian: حجم کار در هفته امتحانات پایانی برای بیشتر دانشجویان بسیار شدید و طاقت‌فرسا به نظر می‌رسید.

miniContext: The workload during finals week felt overwhelming to most students.

examples.english: His explanation for being late sounded plausible, so the teacher let it go.
examples.persian: توضیح او برای تاخیرش قابل قبول و باورپذیر به نظر می‌رسید، پس معلم از آن گذشت.

miniContext: His explanation for being late sounded plausible, so the teacher let it go.

examples.english: Relying on a single supplier for all parts proved problematic during the shortage.
examples.persian: تکیه بر یک تامین‌کننده برای همه قطعات در زمان کمبود مسئله‌دار بود.

miniContext: Relying on a single supplier for all parts proved problematic during the shortage.

examples.english: The patient made a remarkable recovery just two weeks after surgery.
examples.persian: بیمار تنها دو هفته پس از جراحی بهبودی چشمگیری پیدا کرد.

miniContext: The patient made a remarkable recovery just two weeks after surgery.

examples.english: The region suffered severe drought for the third year in a row.
examples.persian: این منطقه برای سومین سال متوالی خشکسالی شدیدی را تجربه کرد.

miniContext: The region suffered severe drought for the third year in a row.

examples.english: The discovery of the new fossil was a significant breakthrough for paleontologists.
examples.persian: کشف فسیل جدید یک پیشرفت مهم و قابل توجه برای دیرین‌شناسان بود.

miniContext: The discovery of the new fossil was a significant breakthrough for paleontologists.

examples.english: After months of treatment, the patient's condition finally became stable.
examples.persian: پس از ماه‌ها درمان، وضعیت بیمار سرانجام باثبات شد.

miniContext: After months of treatment, the patient's condition finally became stable.

examples.english: She gave a subtle hint about the surprise party without revealing the secret.
examples.persian: او اشاره‌ای ظریف و غیرمستقیم به مهمانی سورپرایز داد بدون آنکه راز را فاش کند.

miniContext: She gave a subtle hint about the surprise party without revealing the secret.

examples.english: Newborn animals are especially vulnerable to predators in the first few weeks.
examples.persian: حیوانات نوزاد در چند هفته اول به طور خاص در برابر شکارچیان آسیب‌پذیر هستند.

miniContext: Newborn animals are especially vulnerable to predators in the first few weeks.
